title: Consistently great service and support
content: I have been with this surgery 40yrs, the doctors in my surgery are great, the appointment booking system works and not a free for all and the receptionists provide great support given they are so busy.  I like to see one particular doctor and appreciate I may have to wait but I'm fitted in as quickly as they can and I feel I'm looked after by my doctor.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
